LanguageData.VGE_TargetingConsole.label: targeting console
LanguageData.VGE_TargetingConsole.description: A large targeting console capable of managing up to three gravship artillery pieces. Requires a crew member to manually aim and fire the weapons. It draws power directly from the grav engine.
LanguageData.VGE_GravshipMinigunTurret.label: gravship minigun turret
LanguageData.VGE_GravshipMinigunTurret.description: A compact gravship-mounted heavy automatic turret. Its multi-barrel mechanism unleashes sustained fire at high speed, shredding lightly armored targets at mid-range. It may explode when damaged.
LanguageData.VGE_Gun_GravshipMinigun.label: gravship minigun
LanguageData.VGE_GravshipAutocannonTurret.label: gravship autocannon turret
LanguageData.VGE_GravshipAutocannonTurret.description: A compact gravship-mounted automatic turret. Its large-caliber shells do heavy damage over significant ranges, but despite its efficiency, the barrel must be refurbished after heavy use. It cannot fire at close-up targets, and may explode when damaged. Needs to be constructed on substructure.
LanguageData.VGE_Gun_GravshipAutocannon.label: gravship autocannon
LanguageData.VGE_Bullet_GravshipAutocannon.label: autocannon shell
LanguageData.VGE_GravshipUraniumSlugTurret.label: gravship uranium slug turret
LanguageData.VGE_GravshipUraniumSlugTurret.descriptio: A compact gravship-mounted armor-piercing turret. Its ultra-dense uranium shells can punch through heavy armor, but it requires new uranium slugs to be loaded after use. More efficient than its ground version, it consumes fewer slugs per shot. It's more accurate at longer ranges, and can't fire at all close up. May explode when damaged. Needs to be constructed on substructure.
LanguageData.VGE_Gun_GravshipUraniumSlug.label: gravship uranium slug gun
LanguageData.VGE_Bullet_GravshipUraniumSlug.label: uranium slug
LanguageData.VGE_GaussHowitzer.label: gauss howitzer
LanguageData.VGE_GaussHowitzer.description: A triple-barrel electromagnetic artillery piece that fires dense uranium slugs at high velocity. Designed for both local bombardments and long-range engagements, it can also target other gravships in orbit. Requires a linked targeting terminal with an operator to function. It draws power directly from the grav engine.
LanguageData.VGE_Gun_GaussHowitzer.label: gauss howitzer
LanguageData.VGE_Bullet_GaussHowitzer.label: Gauss howitzer shot
LanguageData.VGE_JavelinLauncher.label: javelin launcher
LanguageData.VGE_JavelinLauncher.description: A heavy multi-tube missile platform that fires a spread of 12 long-range guided astrofuel-propelled javelins. Designed for saturation strikes against surface targets and rival gravships in orbit. Requires a linked targeting terminal with an operator to function. It draws power directly from the grav engine.
LanguageData.VGE_Gun_JavelinLauncher.label: javelin launcher
LanguageData.VGE_Gun_JavelinLauncher.description: A multi-tube javelin launcher for gravship use. Requires a linked, manned targeting terminal to operate.
LanguageData.VGE_Rocket_JavelinLauncherRocket.label: Javelin rocket
LanguageData.VGE_AnticraftEmitter.label: anticraft emitter
LanguageData.VGE_AnticraftEmitter.description: A large, gravship-mounted energy weapon that projects a concentrated cutting beam capable of slicing through armor and hull plating. Designed to counter enemy gravships in orbit, it unleashes devastating continuous fire. Requires a linked targeting terminal with an operator to function. Uses a lot of power to fire.
LanguageData.VGE_Gun_AnticraftEmitter.label: anticraft emitter
LanguageData.VGE_Gun_AnticraftEmitter.description: A large energy weapon that projects a cutting beam.
LanguageData.VGE_Bullet_AnticraftEmitter.label: anticraft emitter beam
LanguageData.VGE_Gravmine.label: gravmine
LanguageData.VGE_Gravmine.description: A high-explosive device designed for space-based combat. It features a large detection radius that triggers a powerful blast detonation upon the approach of any target, including enemy gravships. It can only be constructed in space.
LanguageData.VGE_LargeGravshipShieldGenerator.label: large gravship shield generator
LanguageData.VGE_LargeGravshipShieldGenerator.descrip: A large-scale shielding device that can protect a gravship. It modulates the grav field to create a short-lived momentum repulsor surface that blocks projectiles. It works against normal shots and mortars. Those inside can still shoot out. It must be charged before use. Active shields generate structural heat which if not absorbed by heatsinks, will be vented into the gravship. One gravship can support two large gravship shield generators.
